## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while regime flags rising credit stress and cyclical contraction (HYG/LQD signal); HYG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY confirms mixed risk signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling). Credit stress signaling strain: HYG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY — HYG/LQD flagged downward. Reflation bid intact: CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-cautious: SPY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY — SPY/TLT flat and Stocks vs Bonds in CORRECTION. Dollar modestly stronger (level rising) while yield cues remain mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Technology holding but soft: XLK (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND while Financials lag intraday: XLF (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION; Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US steady: SPY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND. EM and Europe outpace China: EEM (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND and VGK (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +3.94%) ABOVE TREND while FXI (1W: +0.10% | 1M: -1.11%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculative flows waning: ARKK (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND; small caps under pressure: IWM (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION. Speculation index and small vs large both cooling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Precious metals and base metals leadership: SLV (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND. Gold softer on the week: GLD (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +2.84%) CORRECTION — rotation within commodities.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy showing breadth: XLE (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND while Brent BNO (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND. Natural gas bounce is volatile: UNG (1W: +10.72% | 1M: -10.93%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND show consistent strength. DIVERGENCE (MINOR): XLF (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY — watch cross-asset momentum.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor selective cyclicals and commodity exposures showing strength (XLE (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to high-volatility speculative ETFs (ARKK (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND, IBIT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND) given mixed credit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND if CPER keeps firming. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.00%) CORRECTION and Financials XLF (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION if credit cues deteriorate.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND for reflation signals. BEARISH: Oil BNO (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND and volatile Natural Gas UNG (1W: +10.72% | 1M: -10.93%) RECOVERY to monitor for mean reversion.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~26.3 (complacency still fragile), HYG/LQD dispersion ~ watch HYG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY, CPER strength (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND as reflation trigger, XLK/XLF relative ratio for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND but credit signal flagged negative. Commodities and energy (SLV (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while small caps and speculative ETFs (IWM (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND) show weakness to monitor. Key risk: credit spread/credit-signal divergence (HYG vs LQD) and minor trend mismatches in XLF and TLT.
